title: Flashbulb
summary: Flashbulb is a spell that creates an extremely bright flash around the caster's fingers. The effect can be used to temporarily blind an opponent, and is so bright that the caster will opt to wear eye protection themselves.

'''Flashbulb''' is a spell that creates an extremely bright flash around the caster's fingers. The effect can be used to temporarily blind an opponent, and is so bright that the caster will opt to wear eye protection themselves. 

== History ==
Flashbulb was used by [[Grier]] to temporarily blind two workers during an [[Organization]] hijack on their lorry. {{source|SAS-130}}
